log.msg: Dawn, day 1. Salt Flats. Hot days, thin water, dust on the wind.
Somewhere to the west there is a town. Find it: its people know what this land is waiting for.
Your camp has a well. A cloak, a lantern and fuel are stored here: open Pack to take them.
A hard winter. Everything is colder, and storms come more often.
A small world, 3 regions by 3: the places of the story are close together, and the far country is never far.
You step onto salt pan. Flat, fast and exposed.
You sight: spring to the north-west.
Paved road underfoot. The going is fast and easy.
